## Essential test sets
- Happy path, state validation, partial and cancellation/return path.
- Tax/FX/rounding, ledger and stock consistency where relevant.
- Different legal-company record access, unauthorized posting/approvals/export.
- Duplicate integration request, timeout/retry and concurrently edited state.
- Historical data migration/replay and rollback when applicable.
- UI keyboard/mobile/RTL and accessible error messages where required.
